title: Grammar: aimer and préférer with a noun
subtitle: Unit 14: Free time and simple plans

steps.title: aimer and préférer with a noun
steps.body: Use aimer or préférer to say what you like or choose. Put a general activity noun after the verb with le, la or les. Put another verb in its infinitive form when you like doing an action.

steps.title: Use the definite article for a general like
aimer and préférer with a noun
steps.body:
• For a general like or preference, use le, la or les before the activity noun: J'aime le hockey; j'aime la musique.
• Use aimer to say what you like. Use préférer to say which of two or more choices you like more.
• Do not copy the English pattern I like music word for word. In French, say J'aime la musique.
